citations.context: Again, another example. After providing various examples to illustrate the danger of false teachers, Jude then goes on to actually quote from first Enoch as though it were authentic. In verses 14 and 15, speaking of the false teachers, Jude declares, and I quote, it was of these also that Enoch, in the seventh generation from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with his holy myriads to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their deeds of ungodliness, which they have committed in such an ungodly way, and of all the harsh things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
